services.name: Paddleboard Rental
services.desc: We offer free delivery and pickup for surfboards and stand-up paddleboards within the Freeport and Village of Surfside Beach city limits. Want to surf at Quintana Beach? We’ve got you covered with free delivery there too! For surrounding areas, delivery is available for a small additional fee. Looking for a self-service option? Visit our kayak and paddleboard rental kiosk at 1300 West 2nd Street, Freeport, TX, 77541. Using our easy mobile app, you can rent gear anytime and enjoy the Old Brazos River or take your equipment to any location of your choice. Surfboards - Board sizes range from 6′ to 10′ . Hard top or foam boards available. $50 a day per surfboard - You can use as long as you

includes: Leash and paddle included with paddleboard rental
Jet ski rental includes 2 riders, children 16 and younger ride free
gap: Age minimum for kayak rentals not stated
blurb: Guests can rent kayaks, jet skis, surfboards, paddleboards, and other water sports gear. Guided kayak tours and jet ski dolphin tours are available. Rentals include options for self-service via a mobile app and delivery to surrounding areas for a fee.
extraNote: No refunds for cancellations, missing required items, or failure to follow rules · Late arrival results in no refund; rescheduling possible based on availability · Reservations required for jet ski rentals; same day reservations possible if available · Must follow all State, City, and Federal laws while operating jet ski · No drug or alcohol use permitted while operating or riding jet ski · Jet skis must be kept below 35 MPH and slow to 5 MPH near people or no wake zones · Old Brazos River – Freeport Splash Park Location, 1300 West 2nd Street, Freeport, Texas, 77541
